brief.regime: Market breadth remains decisively negative with 1,358 declines against 532 advances, as the Nifty (+0.58%) and Bank Nifty (+0.89%) were led higher by Large caps while Midcap (-0.58%) and Smallcap (-0.53%) indices declined. FMCG (+1.87%) and PSU Bank (+0.50%) were top gainers while Pharma (-1.53%) and Metals (-1.50%) dragged, pushing India VIX up 1.15% to 15.68. Macro pressures persist with US 10-year yields at 5.15% and Brent crude at $94.82/bbl, though the rupee held at 93.92 supported by nearly $10 billion in November equity inflows.

Gained 19.99% with 28.6x average volume despite no fresh regulatory filings or news disclosures reported.

week: Mahanadi Coalfields mainboard IPO expected with a price band of ₹129-136 per share and an issue size of ₹8,981 crore.

risks: Weak market breadth with over 2.5 declining stocks for every advance reflecting concentrated selling in mid and small caps.
Elevated US 10-year treasury yields at 5.15% and DXY at 103.53 creating foreign capital flow volatility.
Severe post-earnings downside risk in mid/small caps reporting margin compressed or negative growth, triggering sharp single-day drawdowns.
